fixes.explanation: Abraham is a big name, and I get why it jumped out at you. Big names grab the eye, friend, like the biggest cookie on the cooling rack. But look at what Paul says right before this: he isn't seeking his own good, but the good of many, that they may be saved. (1 Corinthians 10:33) Then he says, “You are to imitate me, just as I imitate Christ.” (1 Corinthians 11:1) Christ is the One he follows, and Abraham isn't named anywhere in this passage.
